// Purpose : This script can be used with Cheetah3D to generate a series of images around an object.
// These images can then be used, with another program like Object2VR
// to generate a QTVR object movie or a Flash object movie
// This script has been tested with Cheetah3D version 5.7 under Snow Leopard
//	
// Installation : To use it, place it into your "scripts/Tag" folder.
// More instructions in the attached ReadMe file and the script itself

Feel free to correct it or modify it for your own use or the C3D community

Attachments: [Archive.zip](https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?attachments/15245/)
